analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 29.7, entering oversold territory, below 30 for 5 consecutive days. ADX at 40.9 indicates a clear trend, but -DI (30.7) remains stronger than +DI (17.9), suggesting continued downside pressure. MACD histogram shows improvement, but it's too weak to signal a trend reversal. Trading volume is subdued at 0.72x the 5-day average. Price is attempting a bounce near the 52-week low of $0.87, but confirmation is needed above the swing support at $0.89.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($0.92) vs SMA5 ($0.93)/SMA20 ($1.01)/SMA50 ($1.15): Below short-term and mid-term trends, entering weak territory.
· Position vs SMA100 ($1.30)/SMA200 ($1.23): Below long-term trends, maintaining strong weakness.
· 52-week position (3.3%) + Current price range near historical lows, potential for bounce.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (29.2→29.7) + Entered oversold territory, suggesting potential for a rebound.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.0072→0.0019) + Improvement diagnosed, but weak signal for trend reversal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $0.83) + Bandwidth at 36.04%, indicating a period of expanded volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($0.89) + Adjacent to 52-week low $0.87, forming a strong support zone.
· Swing resistance ($1.13) + Overlaps with SMA50/EMA50 resistance, expecting trend reversal upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (5-day low $0.87, 20-day low $0.87): Sideways range, no trend formation.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.72x) + Decreased reliability of movement, indicating sluggish action.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase) + Buy on confirmation of $0.89 support, expecting bullish turn on breakout above $1.13 resistance.
